title: Schedules
description: Plan processes to run automatically (e.g. weekly health checks, quarterly access reviews). Scheduled runs use the rights of the schedule's owner; runs that need a decision wait in My tasks.

form.name: Name
form.rightsOwner: Scheduled runs execute with the rights of {{owner}}; they are skipped and logged if the owner loses access to the process or a platform.
form.rightsYou: Scheduled runs execute with the rights of you (the owner); they are skipped and logged if the owner loses access to the process or a platform.
form.overlapHint: Off: a new run is skipped while the previous one is still running or waiting for a decision.
